evidence_items.explanation: The authors verify an AI-generated unit-distance disproof, and Gowers judges it worthy of the Annals of Mathematics. This is substantial counterevidence before either deadline, although Gowers expressly distinguishes problem solving from other mathematical activities.

evidence_items.locator: Section 1, item A, Reliable autonomous research
evidence_items.explanation: Aletheia supplies additional evidence of autonomous research before the deadline. The authors also state that their autonomous results are not claimed as major mathematical advances, so this does not independently settle the world-class threshold.

unresolved_gaps: The records establish exceptional research output but do not settle whether the system had the broader capability meant by 'world-class mathematicians'.
No agreed measure connects a single major result to the forecast's capability threshold.
The search does not establish a comprehensive negative finding across AI systems at the deadline.
